digest.component_or_area: LLM provider parity harness and Bedrock infrastructure
propositions: Bedrock inference-profile ids must be probed for invokability in the project AWS account (896586841071/us-east-1) before corpus spend; temperature=0 rejection on opus-4-8 is expected and handled by existing supports_temperature override.

The paired corpus run must pool gold-labeled cases across specs to meet the MIN_GOLD_ITEMS=20 floor; stratified sampling yields 30 items (15 block, 15 advisory) from 15 specs, excluding agentic ops that bypass resolve_gate_config.

Provider must be the only differing variable between v1 (direct Anthropic) and v2 (Bedrock) arms; per-pass model mapping must be explicit to avoid split-brain where bare claude-* ladder entries route to direct Anthropic instead of Bedrock.

The parity bar (structured-output validity, zero decision-level flips, recall/false-accept within 2pp, zero runtime error rate, gold-coverage ≥20) measures payload and tool parity rather than verdict equivalence; LLM non-determinism is expected and non-gating.

Provider-clean routing must be proven via REBAR_USAGE_LOG per-call model tally showing zero non-Bedrock calls on v2 arms; all capability differences (e.g. temperature rejection) must be explicit and recorded rather than silent.
